definitions.explanation: the quality of food being substantial or satisfying, either in portion size, texture, or richness

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{食|た}べごたえがある。
examples.english: This dish is filling and satisfying.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べごたえのあるステーキだった。
{量|りょう}は{少|すく}ないが{食|た}べごたえは{十分|じゅうぶん}だ。
examples.english: The portion is small, but it's quite filling.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {食|た}べ (eating, from {食|た}べる)
- ごたえ ({応|こた}え) - response, feedback, resistance

RELATED 〜ごたえ COMPOUNDS:
- {歯|は}ごたえ (texture when biting, chewiness)
- {手|て}ごたえ (response, feedback)
- {見|み}ごたえ (worth seeing, impressive to look at)
- {読|よ}みごたえ (worth reading, substantial read)

USAGE:
- {食|た}べごたえがある (to be filling/satisfying)
- {食|た}べごたえ{十分|じゅうぶん} (plenty satisfying)
